title: mRemoteNG always opens on monitor 2
author: n3cr0cr0w
body_snippet:
Description
mRemoteNG always opens on monitor 2, even when it is launched from the Start menu on monitor 1.

Nightly Build

Date: 20260817
Commit: [80f7a96]

Installed from: [mRemoteNG-nightly-20260817-v1.83.0-80f7a96-x64.msi]


I only use mRemoteNG on monitor 1, so this does not appear to be caused by restoring a previously saved window position. The application is not intentionally used on monitor 2.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for the detailed report. Some context on how the window is placed: mRemoteNG restores its last saved position and size at startup; a fresh install has no saved position yet, so the very first placement is decided by Windows' default (which favors the *primary* display, not the monitor the Start menu was on). After that, wherever the window is when you close the app is where it should come back.
